scope.system: GLM-4.7-Flash Aider Polyglot C++ supervised fine-tuning
scope.purpose: Complete, evidence-linked inventory of defects that can prevent SFT data or training from improving first-turn executable repository edits.
out_of_scope: Claiming that any listed diagnosis is fixed
Promoting a checkpoint from training loss alone

sft_dataset_size_invariant.policy: Rows rejected as positive supervision must be repaired, replaced, or backfilled with independently verified rows. Quality work must not reduce the unique packaged corpus below 790. Tail-batch remediation must consume all rows or backfill; it must not shrink the corpus to a convenient multiple.

defects.finding: The raw-715 audit found zero rows ready for training without review.
defects.remediation: Reverify every retained row and record an executable semantic receipt.
defects.acceptance_test: Every positive row has a passing row-level receipt and an explicit disposition.

defects.finding: Seventy-two raw-715 rows are classified reject.
defects.remediation: Remove them from positive supervision only after one-for-one repair, replacement, or backfill.
defects.acceptance_test: No rejected row remains positive and the packaged dataset still contains at least 790 unique rows.

defects.finding: Six hundred forty-three raw-715 rows remain review-only.
defects.remediation: Resolve review rows with compile, test, interface, and semantic checks.
defects.acceptance_test: No review-only row is silently promoted to positive supervision.

defects.finding: Twenty-five raw-715 answers fail compilation.
defects.remediation: Repair or replace each compile-failing answer.
defects.acceptance_test: All positive answers compile in their declared fixture.

defects.finding: The audit contains 40 contradictory prompt pairs.
defects.remediation: Resolve each pair using executable correctness and provenance.
defects.acceptance_test: No normalized prompt maps to incompatible positive targets.

defects.finding: Seven rows conflict with Gold targets.
defects.remediation: Adjudicate conflicts and retain only the verified target.
defects.acceptance_test: Every Gold conflict has a decision, receipt, and superseded-row link.

defects.finding: One hundred four raw-715 rows have unresolved lineage.
defects.remediation: Attach immutable source, transform, and parent identifiers.
defects.acceptance_test: Every positive row has reconstructable lineage.

defects.finding: Sixty raw-715 records lack the example needed to audit the target.
defects.remediation: Restore the missing fixture or replace the row.
defects.acceptance_test: Each positive row is self-contained enough for deterministic replay.

defects.finding: Six hundred six raw-715 answers are dense or minified, weakening edit pedagogy and auditability.
defects.remediation: Normalize style without changing semantics, then replay verification.
defects.acceptance_test: Style gates flag no unreadable positive target.

defects.finding: No raw-715 row has an independent row-level semantic receipt.
defects.remediation: Generate immutable compile, test, sanitizer, and contract receipts per row.
defects.acceptance_test: Receipt coverage equals positive-row count.

defects.finding: Raw-715 supplies 81.71% of the 875-row raw-concat mixture that regressed from SFT v2.
defects.remediation: Keep raw-715 out of positive mixtures until adjudicated.
defects.acceptance_test: Promotion tests show no pass@1 or multi-turn-with-error-feedback@2 regression versus the declared baseline.

defects.finding: The v4 package verifies the 260 new rows strongly, but does not independently replay all 530 inherited rows.
defects.remediation: Replay the same strict checks over inherited and new rows.
defects.acceptance_test: All 790 rows pass one uniform verification pipeline.

defects.finding: Exact fixed-26 overlap is zero, but semantic contamination has not been fully excluded.
defects.remediation: Run AST, behavior, and problem-concept similarity audits against fixed-26.
defects.acceptance_test: Every near match is adjudicated and held-out claims exclude contaminated rows.

defects.finding: Quality filtering can falsely improve audit rates by shrinking the 790-row corpus.
defects.remediation: Enforce repair, replacement, or backfill for every rejected positive row.
defects.acceptance_test: The verified unique packaged corpus remains at least 790 rows after every intervention.

defects.finding: All 715 raw rows were exposed as usable by the earlier API even though the later audit found zero train-ready rows.
defects.remediation: Make the audited disposition authoritative and remove permissive legacy labels.
defects.acceptance_test: No consumer can select a row as positive when its current audited disposition is review or reject.

defects.finding: Seven hundred five of 715 raw answers share the same curriculum namespace, indicating a highly concentrated generation lineage.
defects.remediation: Measure generator, template, and solution-family diversity before treating row count as independent coverage.
defects.acceptance_test: The corpus report separates unique behavioral coverage from repeated generator style.

defects.finding: The 600-row pass1-skills mixture achieved 0/26 pass@1 and 2/26 multi-turn-with-error-feedback@2, so its added skill rows did not transfer under that run.
defects.remediation: Audit the skill labels, target correctness, and mixture weights before reuse.
defects.acceptance_test: A matched ablation shows positive first-turn transfer before this mixture is promoted.

defects.finding: SFT v1 consumed 320 of 321 packaged rows.
defects.remediation: Make tail handling explicit and consume all unique rows.
defects.acceptance_test: The epoch receipt accounts for all 321 row identities.

defects.finding: SFT v2 consumed 1,184 of 1,211 packaged rows.
defects.remediation: Use a non-dropping final batch or deterministic backfill.
defects.acceptance_test: The epoch receipt accounts for all 1,211 row identities.

defects.finding: SFT v3 and both v4 schedules drop tail rows; v4 consumes 780 of 790 each epoch.
defects.remediation: Consume the final ten rows without reducing the packaged dataset.
defects.acceptance_test: Each v4 epoch accounts for 790 distinct row identities.

defects.finding: Current receipts do not expose the row identities consumed at each optimizer step.
defects.remediation: Log deterministic row IDs and packed-sample membership.
defects.acceptance_test: A run can reconstruct row coverage and repetition per epoch.

defects.finding: The corpus has no checked-in per-row token-length and truncation report.
defects.remediation: Record raw, rendered, packed, and truncated token counts per row.
defects.acceptance_test: The report proves whether every target fits the training window.

defects.finding: Training is capped at 4,096 tokens while evaluation permits outputs up to 32,768 tokens.
defects.remediation: Measure failure sensitivity to training-window coverage before changing the cap.
defects.acceptance_test: A length-stratified evaluation quantifies the train/eval window mismatch.

defects.finding: The pass1-skills-600 experiment used a 3,072-token sequence length despite data fitting 4,096.
defects.remediation: Match sequence length when comparing data interventions.
defects.acceptance_test: Ablations vary one declared factor and record the effective token cap.

defects.finding: No disjoint validation split is reported for SFT training.
defects.remediation: Create immutable train, validation, and fixed-26 holdout boundaries.
defects.acceptance_test: Training receipts include non-overlapping split manifests.

defects.finding: W&B reports training loss but no validation loss or executable validation score.
defects.remediation: Log validation loss and first-turn executable metrics at fixed intervals.
defects.acceptance_test: Every promoted run has synchronized train and validation curves.

defects.finding: There is no evidence-based early stopping criterion.
defects.remediation: Predeclare a validation-based checkpoint selection rule.
defects.acceptance_test: Checkpoint choice follows the recorded rule rather than final-step convenience.

defects.finding: Intermediate checkpoints from the three-epoch run were not all evaluated on fixed-26.
defects.remediation: Evaluate each saved epoch or selected interval under one harness.
defects.acceptance_test: A checkpoint-by-checkpoint table identifies the actual behavioral frontier.

defects.finding: Schedule comparisons are not compute- and token-matched.
defects.remediation: Report seen tokens, optimizer updates, effective batches, and wall time.
defects.acceptance_test: Comparative claims use matched budgets or state the confound.

defects.finding: Data interventions have not been isolated from simultaneous schedule and sequence-length changes.
defects.remediation: Run one-factor ablations against a frozen recipe.
defects.acceptance_test: Each ablation changes one declared variable.

defects.finding: Reported SFT benchmark results are single-seed measurements.
defects.remediation: Repeat promoted recipes with predeclared seeds.
defects.acceptance_test: Results include dispersion or an explicit single-seed limitation.

defects.finding: V4 performs only 39 optimizer steps per epoch.
defects.remediation: Interpret epoch count jointly with optimizer updates and tokens seen.
defects.acceptance_test: Run summaries state all three quantities.

defects.finding: Falling training loss did not produce a monotonic fixed-26 improvement, so undertraining is not established as the primary cause.
defects.remediation: Treat data-target alignment, validation, and checkpoint selection as competing diagnoses.
defects.acceptance_test: Any undertraining claim is supported by matched learning curves and held-out improvement.

defects.finding: The three-epoch run reports a mean wait ratio of 54.67%, but the waiting source is not attributed in the run receipt.
defects.remediation: Break wait time down by data loading, synchronization, checkpointing, and tracking.
defects.acceptance_test: The next receipt attributes wait time and reports throughput from the same interval.

defects.finding: The observed first-turn frontier is only 1 of 26 tasks.
defects.remediation: Prioritize first-turn interface fidelity and executable correctness targets.
defects.acceptance_test: A promoted checkpoint exceeds 1/26 first-turn passes under the frozen harness.

defects.finding: Assisted performance varies non-monotonically across SFT versions and epochs.
defects.remediation: Use task-level regression gates, not aggregate score alone.
defects.acceptance_test: Promotion reports recovered, retained, and regressed tasks.

defects.finding: Some repair attempts exhaust context or fail to converge after feedback.
defects.remediation: Train concise diagnosis-to-patch examples and measure context use.
defects.acceptance_test: Repair traces remain within the declared budget and improve executable outcomes.

defects.finding: Well-formed output is much more common than executable success.
defects.remediation: Separate formatting supervision from compile, interface, and semantic targets.
defects.acceptance_test: Evaluation reports format, compile, interface, test, and semantic stages separately.

defects.finding: Sixteen of twenty terminal v4 three-epoch failures are interface or compile-contract failures.
defects.remediation: Add verified examples that preserve exact headers, types, symbols, ownership, and template visibility.
defects.acceptance_test: Contract-failure count falls on held-out tasks without semantic regression.

defects.finding: Four terminal v4 three-epoch failures are semantic rather than interface failures.
defects.remediation: Add independently verified semantic edge-case coverage.
defects.acceptance_test: Bank-account, dnd-character, yacht, and zebra-puzzle failure classes have targeted held-out analogues.

defects.finding: No completed SFT checkpoint dominates both pass@1 and multi-turn-with-error-feedback@2: v3 leads the feedback-conditioned metric at 7/26, while v1, v2, and v4 one-epoch share the 1/26 pass@1 frontier.
defects.remediation: Use a predeclared multi-metric promotion rule with retained-task gates.
defects.acceptance_test: The selected checkpoint satisfies the rule without hiding a regression in the other metric.

defects.finding: Earlier reporting mislabeled sequential feedback-assisted repair as an independent-sampling metric; the canonical name is multi-turn-with-error-feedback@2.
defects.remediation: Rename the metric assisted-pass-by-attempt-2 in new reports while preserving legacy mapping.
defects.acceptance_test: No report conflates assisted repair with independent pass@k.

defects.finding: Repeated tuning on the fixed 26 tasks risks adaptive benchmark overfitting.
defects.remediation: Use fixed-26 for regression and add an untouched promotion set.
defects.acceptance_test: Final promotion is decided on a predeclared untouched split.

defects.finding: Aggregate scores lack uncertainty estimates despite sampling at temperature 0.7.
defects.remediation: Run independent seeds or trials and report intervals.
defects.acceptance_test: Promotion evidence includes uncertainty or is explicitly labeled deterministic/single-trial.

defects.finding: At least one prior evaluation was invalid and had to be excluded because of harness failure.
defects.remediation: Make harness validity a hard precondition with receipts.
defects.acceptance_test: Every score has task count, response count, parser, compile, and test integrity checks.

defects.finding: SFT v2 produced two malformed responses and only 25 well-formed tasks.
defects.remediation: Retain malformed-output accounting as a promotion gate.
defects.acceptance_test: All 26 tasks have auditable response artifacts and format outcomes.

defects.finding: Task transition tables are descriptive but are not yet enforced as regression gates.
defects.remediation: Encode retained-win and maximum-regression thresholds.
defects.acceptance_test: CI rejects a candidate that violates the predeclared task-level gate.

defects.finding: Post-hoc minimal corrections derived from failed responses are useful error analysis but are not independent evidence of model capability.
defects.remediation: Store analyst corrections separately and test any resulting data on untouched tasks.
defects.acceptance_test: Reports label observed model outputs, assisted attempts, and analyst-authored corrections as distinct artifacts.

defects.finding: The v4 one-epoch and three-epoch runs live under different W&B entities.
defects.remediation: Use one controlled entity/project and record immutable run URLs.
defects.acceptance_test: The project owner can access all promoted run histories.

defects.finding: The one-epoch W&B history duplicates steps 0 through 37.
defects.remediation: Use monotonic step keys and reject duplicate metric steps.
defects.acceptance_test: History contains exactly one metric record per declared optimizer step.

defects.finding: The three-epoch run produced three local W&B resume directories under one run ID.
defects.remediation: Record resume lineage and a single canonical history.
defects.acceptance_test: Run receipt enumerates sessions and proves lossless history merging.

defects.finding: The three-epoch shutdown logged transport or EOF errors despite successful HTTP upload responses.
defects.remediation: Add an explicit post-run sync and remote artifact verification gate.
defects.acceptance_test: The receipt proves remote history and artifact completeness after shutdown.

defects.finding: W&B contains no validation metrics for the v4 SFT runs.
defects.remediation: Publish validation loss and executable validation tables.
defects.acceptance_test: A promoted run has queryable validation metrics and samples.

defects.finding: Dataset revision, row manifest, training receipt, checkpoint, W&B run, and evaluation are not uniformly joined by one provenance record.
defects.remediation: Create one immutable run receipt that links every artifact and hash.
defects.acceptance_test: A reviewer can traverse dataset to checkpoint to every response without inference.

defects.finding: The current project account cannot access the W&B entity that owns the three-epoch run.
defects.remediation: Mirror or transfer the run to the controlled project while preserving the original URL and run ID.
defects.acceptance_test: The project owner and designated reviewers can query the complete remote history.
